what_differs: Meetings agreed to remove matching by deal makeup and rely only on the Deal External ID, and Kobi reported it done on 2026-09-01. WAGR-5 (Jumpr Review) still describes a fallback to state/country and partner/operator, with no later comment.
suggested_action: Add a comment to WAGR-5 that records the Deal-External-ID-only rule and the reprocess limitation for clicks without a Deal External ID, so review and UAT test the current behaviour.
